platform.host: Karst 41 runner (docs/ops/remote-runner.md): WSL2 Ubuntu 24.04 on the owner's second workstation
platform.line_endings: LF: each .txt manifest hash is also the committed frame's hash (no committed_lf needed)

inputs_record.form: per case: connect (Telnet NAWS/TERM/COLORTERM), then per capture every string the caller wrote since the previous capture, in order, plus server-side moves as {"move": ...}
inputs_record.comparison: per capture, `segments` in order: {"keys": [...]} must be byte-identical; a loop {"loop", "goal", "may_press", "presses", "reached"} matches when loop, goal and may_press are equal and reached is true; presses is run variance (technical lead, S48c2)

transport: NetBBS Telnet -> registered native stdio, DOOR_KARST41_PRESENTATION=1
fixtures: private node/world/accounts only; normal game rules
committed_note: manifest sha256/bytes are the files as the runner wrote them; the .txt frames are LF and committed byte for byte; .ans/.json are run artifacts kept on the runner
